# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue.

Prefer [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/janolss/rawlabelprint/security/advisories/new) for this repository.  

Include: affected version/OS, steps to reproduce, and impact.

We aim to acknowledge reports within a few days and will coordinate a fix before any public disclosure.

## Scope

Supported: the latest release of RawLabelPrint (macOS, Linux, Windows).

In scope: issues that could lead to unexpected code execution, bypass of the localhost origin allowlist.

Out of scope: denial-of-service against the local agent, unauthorized printing, social engineering, and reports against third-party printers or Zebra Browser Print.
